title_zh: My life — 第2节可背诵讲义
body_en: I live with my family in a small flat. In the morning I pack my school bag and say hello to my neighbours. After class I finish homework first, then I play with friends. At night I read a short story and write three new words. This is my life — simple plans, kind people, and a little English every day.
body_zh: 我和家人住在一套小公寓。早上我收拾书包，跟邻居问好。放学后我先写作业，再和朋友玩。晚上读一篇短故事，写下三个新词。这就是我的生活——简单计划、友善的人，以及每天一点英语。
